qualification: Observed native Base.Nat.read/Nat.show boundaries. This limits representable Core.World clocks and sequences even though the abstract datatype is Nat.
bend_probe_source:
import Base

def observed(result: Maybe<&2, Nat>) -> String:
  match result:
    case None{}: "none"
    case Some{value}: Nat.show(value)

def main() -> IO(Unit):
  do IO<Unit>:
    IO.print(observed(Nat.read("4294967296")))
    IO.print(observed(Nat.read("281474976710655")))
    IO.print(observed(Nat.read("281474976710656")))
    IO.print(observed(Nat.read("18446744073709551616")))
